claim.value: Revision comparisons should use consistent elapsed timing from queue entry through upload completion.
claim.scope: Definition and consistency of the proposed end-to-end timing measurement.

provenance.rationale: The span specifies consistent timing across revisions, both measurement endpoints and validation of comparability despite differing trace coverage.

signal_basis.value: Revision trials report sample counts, fractions exceeding one hour and uncertainty, with workload and load recorded, using queue-entry-to-upload-completion timing whose comparability across revisions has been validated.
signal_basis.scope: Comparable end-to-end elapsed-time observations across tested revisions.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the timing definition, comparability requirement and revision-level observations.
The measurement-consistency claim is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Consistent, validated start and end points make revision comparisons concern the same elapsed-time quantity. With the stated prerequisites satisfied, this licenses the claim within its measurement-definition scope.
uncertainty: No unresolved warrant uncertainty within the stated scope; timing comparability is assumed validated as required.
